title: N1 aged-quote failure rate, pre-registration (committed before the seed block exists)
v2_status: V2 is not deployed on any chain; every measurement is an eth_call at a real historical block with the V2 code+storage injected by stateOverride (built by deploy_state.sh on an anvil fork, TokenSweep.t.sol wiring).
seed: keccak256 hash of the first Ethereum mainnet block whose timestamp is > (commit time of this file + 60 s); verify with: cast block <n> --rpc-url <eth>; the 0x-prefixed block hash, lowercased, is the seed string
sampling: per stratum: rng = random.Random(int(sha256(f'{seed}:{chain}/{size}/{regime}'))); per draw: b = rng.randint(b0, b1) (uniform over the regime's blocks, with replacement), then direction WETH>USDC if rng.random() < 0.5 else USDC>WETH
quote: Quoter.previewAndEncode(tIn, tOut, amountIn, probe, ts(b) + deadline_s) by eth_call at block b (post-state of b); revert or canExecute=0 -> noquote, logged apart, not counted in n
execution: for each delta: e = first block with ts(e) >= ts(b) + delta; N1Probe.run(router, tIn, tOut, amountIn, wrap, calldata) by eth_call at block e with the same calldata (paired across deltas)
outcomes: ok (call succeeded and tokenOut balance delta >= effectiveMinOut) | refuse5 (RouterE(5), below floor) | revert_other (selector) | below_min (success below effectiveMinOut: would be a bug) | rpc_err (3 attempts, backoff 2 s then 4 s). Everything except ok counts as a failure and stays in the denominator; an rpc_err on the quote counts as a failure for every delta

sprt.unit: stratum x delta; a stratum stops at the first draw where all five deltas are decided; a stratum x delta undecided at n_max is reported as not measured

notes: block_time_hint is only the initial bracket of the header search (Base runs ~0.2 s blocks in the recent window, 2 s in the stress window); e is always found by binary search on real headers. Smoke run before this commit: 1 large draw per chain x regime x direction, all 5 deltas ok (not part of the sample).
